text:
maria: quick kickoff  new experiment idea: 'hyperflow starter' — combine a short benchmark narrative in the launch email, 20 starter credits, 3 micro prompt templates, and an inbound routing plan for high-intent signups. goal: measurable bump in 24h first-success and cleaner lead routing into sales/solutions. thoughts?
ashley: love mixing the benchmark narrative in the email. propose 2 creative directions: 'real metric' lane (show a short benchmark: ~120ms median latency on starter prompts) vs 'real story' lane (customer micro-case: how a PM shipped a feature). A/B test those.
jon: routing ops: capture lead_score at signup (basic heuristics: company email domain, team_size field, usage_intent). If lead_score > 60 -> route to sales as warm lead + enroll in webinar. Otherwise stay in PLG funnel. We'll need a webhook and a tag on events.
sam: infra constraints: credits expire in 7 days, throttle new accounts 75rpm, set a soft concurrency cap for starter model calls to protect infra. we can gate experiment via flag: hyperflow_v1.
leah: webinar ops: 20-min live + 10-min office hours? might be too long — suggest 15 + 10. Record and create a 45s highlight clip for follow-up. include an explicit CTA to claim credits during follow-up.
maria: cadence draft: 
0h: launch email (benchmark/story variant) + 20 credits + CTA to "use starter prompts"
4h: in-app nudge (1-click apply prompt pack) + microcopy about credit expiry
18h: reminder email + webinar invite + 45s clip snippet for reminder
36h: handoff: if lead_score > 60 and webinar_registered -> create CRM task for AE; else final credit reminder at 48h
48h: credit expiration notice + replay link
jon: CRM handoff details: include event stream with tags: lead_score, signup_intent, model_route, experiment_variant, first_success_timestamp. AE payload should include recent prompt examples used and first_success flag.
ashley: subject lines to test: 
- variant A (benchmark): "See Redwood starter latency: 120ms + 20 credits"
- variant B (story): "How a PM shipped with 3 prompts (+20 credits)"
A/B top 2. we'll keep creative tight.
leah: webinar landing page copy: headline = "20 credits + 15-min demo: Ship a quick LLM feature". add a small bulleted benchmark section: latency, cost-per-token illustration. include a CTA for sales-warm leads.
maria: prompt pack rules: 3 prompts max, each one-line, include seed_input and expected_outcome. store immutable pack: PromptPack/hyperflow_v1. keep total expected tokens low (<200 tokens per prompt) to control cost.
sam: analytics/event keys: experiment_created, email_sent, credits_granted, prompt_pack_applied, prompt_executed, first_success, webinar_registered, crm_handoff. ensure each event includes model_name and route_variant.
jon: segmentation: add a quick signup checkbox "Are you evaluating for internal search/docs/chat/code?" map to prompt pack lane. low friction.
maria: benchmark narrative specifics: pick a representative starter prompt (e.g., short summarization of a changelog) and report median latency + tokens for that prompt in an internal benchmark. creative will reference that number as an example. be careful about overpromising.
nashley: creative deliverables: email A/B copy, in-app nudge copy, 45s highlight clip, 3 prompt templates + seed inputs, webinar landing copy. I'll deliver by Thu EOD.
leah: ops for webinar: auto-register + include sales-warm tag. post-webinar follow-up: clip + transcript + CTA to use credits.
sam: rollout plan: create flag hyperflow_v1, start 10% traffic Fri 9am PT for 24h, monitor first_success and cost-per-activation. ramp to 40% if no regressions. alert if avg latency >2s for starter prompts or cost/activation > $1.25.
maria: success metrics: 24h first_success >= 35%; lead routing accuracy (manual check sample) >= 80% for lead_score>60; cost per activated user < $0.75.
jon: QA: I'll ship a small test harness that simulates 100 starter flows to verify metrics and routing. also include a smoke test for CRM handoff webhook.
sam: runbook essentials: how to pause experiment (disable flag), revoke credits (if needed), throttle adjustments, who to page (eng-runtime), and dashboard to track experiment metrics. i'll draft and post link.
maria: small messaging iteration idea: after 1k sends, pull top 10 subject lines by open and rerun a micro-A/B on the landing CTA phrasing. iterate quickly.
nashley: microcopy idea for urgency: show a live counter "X credits remaining" for the cohort on the landing page (fake scarcity for effect) — keep transparent, e.g., "credits reserved for 7 days". A/B test with and without.
leah: for sales-handoff, include a 1-click "request demo" button in follow-up that creates a CRM task with context (prompt examples, first_success status).
growth-bot: experiment created: hyperflow_v1 (id: exp_20270415_14). traffic: 10% initial, auto-ramp rules to 40% if no regressions in 48h. alerts: pause thresholds set.
maria: timeline: drafts by Thu, infra hooks Fri AM, soft launch Fri 9am PT 10% -> review Mon sync. I'll drop prompt-pack drafts + benchmark snippet here when ready. keep replies short so we can move fast.
nashley: :rocket:
maria: thanks all. will post assets here.
